purpose: Requirements for the information a ToC manages, content hash rules, change detection against an existing ToC, and ToC build, update and finalization, with acceptance criteria.
summary: Information managed in the ToC: document information, section entries and reference entries
Limits for AI generated fields: description limit L and internal tolerance H = floor(L x 1.3), with H never shown to the generating AI
Change detection: new, body change, reference change, move or rename, leaving the Index target, no change
Content hash rules: SHA-256 of the original text, excluding the title of formal references
When the reflected hash is updated, tied to ToC finalization
ToC build and rebuild procedure in three stages, with per-key independence
Update plan and generation of document information and AI generated fields only where needed
Reconstruction of references and check states from directory search results
ToC candidate validation and atomic finalization, keeping the last good ToC on failure
tasks: Implementing change detection and the change set
Implementing AI generated field generation and limit validation
Designing the ToC data model and storage
Writing tests for ToC acceptance criteria
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — [ToC]管理
